issue_context.title: Need trace info in `union scan executor`
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
``` mysql
create table t1(a int, b int, c int);
insert into t1 values (1, 1, 1);
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
insert into t1 select * from t1;
create sequence s;
update t1 set a=nextval(s);

create table t(a int, b int, c int, unique key idx_a(a, c));
insert into t values (0, 0, 0);
analyze table t;
begin;
insert into t select * from t1;
explain update t set c=4000 where a=0;
trace format='row' update t set c=4000 where a=1;
```
